scope: Classify the existing Apiosk source universe and the new country-source specifications; evaluate public-data plus x402 combinations. No UI, production configuration, purchases or activation changed.

live_catalog.method: Read-only SQL using the source-browser visibility predicates and provider grouping

bazaar.note: Separate Ask-v2 external Bazaar discovery/prepare/purchase code exists. Hidden imports do not prove external discovery unavailable. Paid execution was not tested.

niches.label: Country APIs
niches.purpose: Registers en concrete controles per land: bedrijven, voertuigen, identifiers en fiscale registratie.

niches.label: Open Government & Datasets
niches.purpose: Statistiek, geodata, wetgeving, publicaties, subsidies, aanbestedingen en datasetcatalogi.

niches.label: Enrichment
niches.purpose: Aanvullende bedrijfs-, markt-, nieuws- en risico-informatie, inclusief beheerde toegang tot registers.

niches.label: Search & Tools
niches.purpose: Zoeken, webinhoud ophalen, extractie, domeincontroles en hulpmiddelen voor verwerking.

display_rules: Country remains a shared coverage filter across all four niches. A country landing page shows its registers, datasets and relevant enrichment together.
Primary niche is a navigation home, not an exclusive source type or execution constraint. Secondary listings point to the same source and contracts.
Within a network, classify the individual service/endpoint. A Pulse or Bazaar logo does not describe the capability or evidence quality.
Dataset catalog entries are discovery metadata until a data distribution and executable operation are resolved.
Show official publisher, actual API operator, discovery channel and payment method separately. x402 is not a data-quality class.
Use Known / Access pending / Execution verified as separate states; this research changes none of them.

enrichment_channels.selection: Use a specific CompanyEnrich, FullEnrich, Exa, Firecrawl or other documented operation for a missing requested field.
Separate deterministic data endpoints from AI synthesis; require country scope, original citations and an advantage over Apiosk processing its own data.

enrichment_channels.role: Discovery index for third-party x402 resources
enrichment_channels.selection: Use for gaps after suitable existing accepted sources. Deduplicate already integrated merchants/endpoints; inspect the real publisher.

sirenic_position.role: Specialist registry aggregator and additional company products
sirenic_position.decision: For the same national identity record, choose direct registry OR Sirenic according to tested coverage, freshness, rights, reliability and total cost. Buy both only for a specifically requested independent check with genuinely independent evidence.

routing_proposal: Normalize the request into capabilities, subject identities, country, period and requested fields.
Match exact registered contracts. Retrieve required authoritative records or existing saved results.
Use a tested aggregator as an alternative when it offers suitable coverage/access; do not force direct access at any cost.
Compute requested field gaps; enrich only the missing fields with accepted provider operations.
Search Bazaar for unresolved capability gaps; require admission and a price before execution.
Bind country plus identifier and verify legal-entity-to-domain matches before company enrichment.
Detect duplicate endpoint offers and shared upstream facts across direct, aggregator and discovery routes.
Quote one bounded total/cap, obtain one approval, execute on the backend and preserve saved-result recovery.
Return field-level provenance, observation dates, coverage gaps and clearly separated official facts, third-party estimates and generated analysis.

implementation_changes.change: Add primary_niche, secondary_niches, country coverage, publisher, operator, discovery_channels, upstream_data_family, payment_rail and output_kind at appropriate source/service/operation levels.
Apply four niche filters before pagination and compute counts after grouping; retain Pulse and Bazaar as grouped providers. Add shared country and readiness filters.
Join national registry specifications with existing public datasets and geographically applicable enrichment; do not invent coverage from a global marketing label.
Add field-gap and alternative-route logic on exact accepted contracts. A UI tab alone must never make a source executable.
Preserve country-qualified identity, verified website mapping, original units/dates and factual-versus-estimated fields.
Reuse existing approval/treasury/receipt/recovery paths. Validate provider rights and bounded total cost before admitting a new route.
Expose provider network > service > operation > evidence in source administration. Keep connected-app actions such as CRM export distinct from buying data.

evaluation.design: Compare official-only, official plus selected enrichment, and aggregator alternative on the same 20 public-company cases across NL, FR, FI, CZ and NO. Quote bounded costs before paid runs.
evaluation.decision: Keep enrichment only where it adds requested information or measurable integration/reliability value; reject unsupported exact numbers and redundant generic summaries.
